description: Producing modified copies of a cache record under boundary overrides while always preserving the original key: a no-op copy that supplies no overrides and carries every field through, overriding the length and the id to zero to show zero is treated as a real value rather than a missing one, overriding the validity deadline to zero, and overriding the URL and the entity tag with empty strings.
